name: Solstice-Chain Causeway
core_rationale: Western starlight-chain suspension bridge of Solstice Pendulum Atoll at [0, 1] linking Celestial Astrolabe Sanctuary to the swinging solstice atoll.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Keepers in Celestial Astrolabe Sanctuary say the starlight links of Solstice-Chain Causeway chime in a lower octave as the atoll approaches its winter solstice apogee.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: Luminous violet chain-links and basalt counterweight piers spanning the void east of Celestial Astrolabe Atoll.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: How do the starlight chain-links remain taut when the pendulum reverses direction at solstice noon?

causal_continuity.evidence: Seeds the western entry node [0, 1] of Solstice Pendulum Atoll along scar-vesper-crater.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Luminous violet chain-links and basalt counterweight piers spanning the void.
